name: An Unlicensed Miracle
description:
Sera refuses to call knowledge stolen simply because an evoker claimed to own it.

Explore woodland mansion loot or defeat evokers for their possible drop. Earn End Remastered's magical eye advancement by obtaining the eye. This record keeps working after you use the eye. Eyes are never consumed by this quest. Loot can be random; choose other routes for the portal if a source proves elusive.
